controls_nrpn.description: Every PreenFM2 patch parameter by NRPN (CC 99/98 number, CC 6/38 value; the synth applies it on CC 38). Values are in the synth's own units; parameters with scale 100 are sent as (value - min) * 100. The synth's MIDI Receive setting must include NRPN (default: CC & NRPN). From the PreenFM2 firmware (Ixox/preenfm2, MidiDecoder::decodeNrpn).

stages.title: Sound source
stages.hint: The algorithm wires six operators together; modulation indexes say how strongly one operator bends the next, and operator frequencies set the harmonic ratios.

stages.title: Envelopes
stages.hint: Attack and release of each operator: carriers shape loudness, modulators shape brightness over time.

stages.title: Mixer and filter
stages.hint: Level and pan of the carrier voices, then the filter.

stages.title: Modulation
stages.hint: Three LFOs, the modulation matrix amounts and the performance controllers.

stages.title: Arpeggiator
stages.hint: Plays held notes as a pattern.

note: PreenFM2 is 4-timbre multitimbral (channels 1-4). Presets: Bank Select CC 0 (2 = DX7 banks 0-127; 3 = DX7 banks 128-255) then CC 32 (bank number), then Program Change; per midi.guide. CC labels follow midi.guide. A DX7 bank holds 32 voices, so preset N is bank N div 32, program N mod 32 (checked on hardware: Program Change above 31 does nothing).
